author: Georgi Kalchev (https://402registry.com)
description: Does an AI crawler see your site? Free registry lookup, x402 pricing; checks paid in USDC on Base.
name: 402registry

tools.name: lookup_site
tools.title: Look up a site in the registry
tools.description: Free. The last dated verdict for a website, if it was ever checked and listed: verdict, score, date and badge. An unknown site is a normal answer (known: false), not an error. To get a fresh check, buy one (see get_pricing).

url.description: The https URL (or hostname) of the site, e.g. https://example.com/.

annotations.title: Look up a site in the registry

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.title: Products, prices and x402 payment requirements
tools.description: Every product for sale — the check (one payment, one check) and the catalog snapshot — with its price, the query parameters the paid request needs, and the exact x402 v2 payment requirements. Call this before buying.

annotations.title: Products, prices and x402 payment requirements

tools.name: get_docs
tools.title: Machine documentation
tools.description: The whole machine guide as JSON: quickstart, what each verdict means, packs, the rules every check runs, and every public route.

tools.name: get_service_status
tools.title: Is the service selling right now
tools.description: Whether the service is selling right now, in which mode and on which network, and if not, why not. This is configuration, not liveness: the health endpoint is at /health.

annotations.title: Is the service selling right now
